subject: ClearBank: MAP + Security gates (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA) — timelines and acceptance
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@clearbank.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@clearbank.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:14:00 +0100
Subject: Re: MAP request — security artifacts and data retention

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the intro call last week. Procurement asked me to capture a short MAP so we can align on what ClearBank needs to complete procurement and security acceptance. Specifically we need: SOC 2 attestation (or summary), SIG/CAIQ responses, the proposed DPA with any redlines you expect, and your standard data retention defaults and options (how customer data is stored/retained, KMS/HSM options, retention windows for logs and KV cache).

I attached our security questionnaire (Excel) — fill in any items you can and flag the rest. Target close for procurement is end of April, but security would like the SIG draft by Apr 28 to review before the final procurement sign-off.

Can you confirm turnaround and who on your side owns the technical answers vs legal? Also need a point of contact for SOC 2 exhibits if we require evidence during audit review.

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Ramos
Head of Cloud Risk, ClearBank
Al: +44 7700 900111

Attachment: ClearBank-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 78KB)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@clearbank.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: MAP request — security artifacts and data retention

Hi Alicia — thanks, and appreciate the clear ask. Attaching a first-pass MAP template and our SOC 2 one-pager to speed review.

Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2: We are SOC 2 Type II in scope for the serving runtime and control plane; I attached a summary. For audit exhibits we can share an evidence bundle on an NDA or as part of a secured review session — Rishi will coordinate.
- SIG/CAIQ: We can provide a draft SIG response in ~10 business days, faster for specific high-priority sections.
- DPA: Laura (cc) handles DPA redlines — typical turnaround is 3–5 business days after we receive your standard DPA.
- Data retention: Default customer data retention is 30 days for KV cache, configurable 30/90/365 days for logs and persisted telemetry; we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for production Dedicated/Private deployments.

Proposing a short MAP kickoff on Wed Apr 14 at 11:00 BST to walk the timeline. Let me know if that works.

Thanks — attaching: redwood-map-template.xlsx, redwood-soc2-onepager.pdf

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +44 7700 900222

Attachments: redwood-map-template.xlsx (Excel, 54KB), redwood-soc2-onepager.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@clearbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:20:00 +0100
Subject: Re: MAP request — SIG/technical details

Alicia / team — following up with technical notes to populate SIG sections. High level:

- SIG/CAIQ scope: we will populate Infrastructure, Data Protection, Identity & Access controls, and Artifact/Logging sections first. Expect a first draft by Tue Apr 27, final by Thu Apr 29.
- Data retention specifics: KV cache: ephemeral by default (30s–30m depending on route), persisted model logs & telemetry retention configurable to 30/90/365 days. Audit logs are kept 365 days by default for Dedicated customers; for Hosted we can export logs to your SIEM via streaming.
- KMS: We support BYOK (AWS KMS, Azure KeyVault) for Dedicated/Private; HSM integration available for on-prem deployments — will list supported providers in SIG.
- Evidence: we can reference scoped control IDs from the SOC 2 summary; if you need attachments (SAMs, config screenshots), note which control IDs and we'll collate them.

I'll attach a draft SIG doc with placeholders — please mark priority sections in the questionnaire.

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@clearbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 16:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: DPA redlines and retention questions

Alicia — looping in legal to confirm process. A few notes from our side:

- DPA turnaround: if you can share your standard DPA we will mark redlines and return within 3 business days. Our standard asks: data deletion within 45 days after termination (unless customer requests earlier), subprocessor list and notice, and right to audit with appropriate NDAs in place.
- Data deletion / backups: we delete primary records within the agreed window; backup snapshots may be retained for an additional 30 days for recovery purposes unless otherwise agreed.
- Security exhibits: we can provide control mappings and sample evidence under an NDA or via a secure reviewer session.

Attaching proposed redline skeleton — please send your DPA and we will incorporate.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: dpa-redlines_20270413.docx (Docx, redline skeleton, 34KB)

From: procurement@clearbank.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@clearbank.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@clearbank.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — procurement items

Hi Ben — procurement here. A few items to keep the contract team moving:

1) We need a firm SLA (latency & availability) and credits table for the Hosted and Dedicated options.
2) Final pricing (monthly commit for Dedicated) and a 60‑day e-signature window.
3) DocuSign route for the initial Statement of Work (SoW) — can you send a pre-populated DocuSign link?

Our target remains close by Apr 30 but security sign-off (SIG + DPA) must be in place before the signature. If Redwood can commit to the SIG draft by Apr 28 and DPA redlines returned by Apr 20, procurement can keep the Apr 30 close date.

Tom Nguyen
Procurement Operations, ClearBank
procurement@clearbank.com

Team — thanks for the responses and alignment. Summary and commitments from Redwood:

- Security owner for SOC exhibits & secure review: Rishi Malhotra — will schedule a secure evidence session if needed (hold availability Apr 25–29).
- Legal owner: Laura Bennett — DPA redlines returned by Tue Apr 20 after we receive your standard DPA; proposed deletion window is 45 days with backup snapshot retention of up to 30 additional days unless you request otherwise.
- Procurement asks: we will send a pre-populated DocuSign SoW and the SLA/credits table by Mon Apr 19.

Deliverables / deadlines:
- Apr 16: Redwood provided SOC 2 one-pager & MAP template (done).

- Apr 20: DPA redlines returned (Redwood legal) — pending your DPA.
- Apr 27: SIG/CAIQ first draft (Redwood SE).

- Apr 30: Target contract signature (ClearBank procurement) if security items reviewed.

Attachments included: redwood-map-v2.xlsx (updated MAP with owners), redwood-soc2-onepager.pdf, dpa-redlines_20270413.docx, sig-caiq-draft.docx. Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DEAL-8241), DocuSign (https://www.docusign.com/clearbank/redwood-deal-8241).
